tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: Lists every check BACKLNK can run (id, what it looks at, its scope and limits). Use the ids with run_checks.

tools.name: run_checks
tools.description: Runs BACKLNK checks on one public URL and waits up to about 40 seconds. Returns, per check, its state, summary, counts and the issues and warnings to fix (most important first, with evidence and a recommendation), plus the audit ids for get_report and verify_fixes. Default checks: meta-tags, page-st

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Returns the compact report of an earlier check: state, summary, counts and findings (detail "actions": issues and warnings only, the default; "all": every finding).

tools.name: verify_fixes
tools.description: After the fixes are deployed: re-runs the same check fresh on the same URL and options, waits up to about 40 seconds and returns the comparison with the original run: fixed, new, still open and not re-checked findings.

tools.name: ai_crawler_policy
tools.description: Builds robots.txt lines that allow or block AI crawlers from BACKLNK's reviewed crawler catalog, with what each line does and warnings. Use a preset (block-training: Block AI training, stay in AI search; block-ai: Block AI crawlers, keep search engines; allow-all: Allow every crawler) or decide per

tools.name: usage
tools.description: How many checks this API key has used and has left today and this hour.
